name: Worldz Fee Flow™ V2
scopeRule: Percentages are allocations of eligible collected fee revenue only. They are not token-supply allocations, wallet-transfer taxes, or promises of return.

platformContributionChoice.purpose: WorldzLaunchPad platform operations, owner-led product development, security, hosting, integrations, support and continued LaunchPad build.

worldzCoreFamilyMarketBuys.rule: Each token receives an equal 3% fee-revenue allocation. PNEX/MRCL allocations accrue until a verified canonical mint and executable live route exist; no mint may be guessed.

legacyCore.rule: This is the same permanently closed 12-token Legacy Core allocation. It must never be charged a second time.

BUILD_3.label: BUILD
BUILD_3.intent: Lowest voluntary LaunchPad contribution; highest Treasury/Reserve share.

GROW_5.label: GROW
GROW_5.intent: Balanced default for platform growth and treasury strength.

BOOST_8.label: BOOST
BOOST_8.intent: Highest voluntary LaunchPad contribution; Treasury/Reserve remains protected.

flywheelRules.creatorDeveloper: 10% recurring creator/developer fee reward after actual eligible fee collection.
flywheelRules.launchReferrer: 15% to the recorded launch referrer. Sub-referrals must come from this 15% and cannot increase trader fees.
flywheelRules.legacyCore: 15% to the final 12-token Legacy market-buy ledger.
flywheelRules.worldzCoreFamilyMarketBuys: 12% total: 3% each to WLDZ, RVIV, PNEX and MRCL market-buy ledgers.
flywheelRules.lpGrowth: 10% accrues for staged liquidity additions only after route, price-impact and treasury approval checks.
flywheelRules.launchedTokenBuybackAndBurn: 8% accrues for transparent market buyback followed by verifiable on-chain burn/supply reduction where supported.
flywheelRules.impactCharity: 5% impact allocation, separately accounted; recipient must be explicitly approved and no charity affiliation may be implied without evidence.
flywheelRules.teamBuilderRewards: 5% for verified team/build contributions under the current team registry and proof rules.
flywheelRules.futureTokenDeploymentReserve: 5% reserved for future token minting, metadata, pools, locks, vesting, audits and launch proof costs.
flywheelRules.treasuryReserve: Residual 12% / 10% / 7% depending on BUILD/GROW/BOOST profile; controlled by approved treasury policy.

executionSafety.failClosedRule: If a route, mint, market, liquidity, treasury authority, price-impact or provider check fails, accrue the allocation rather than force execution.
